title: batch release-note aggregation + onboarding compatibility heuristics
author: Nina Kapoor
description: Introduce a release-note aggregation pipeline and a set of light-weight compatibility heuristics for model onboarding. Motivation: as we scale onboarding of open models and variants the manual step of writing changelogs is a bottleneck and we lack early warnings when a new variant may be semantically incompatible with downstream profiles. This PR adds: 1) a templated aggregation step that groups per-model delta entries into human-readable release-note sections (performance regressions/improvements, API/shape changes, quantization notes, dataset/licensing flags); 2) a discoverable 'compat-heuristics' validator that emits advisory warnings when a model/profile pair exhibits high-probability incompatible signals (tokenization changes, vocab size drift, embedding-dim mismatch, output-shape deltas); 3) integration hooks so the release-assembler can include aggregated notes and inline advisories into the final changelog; 4) small UX affordances for model owners to accept/override suggestions. The description below outlines the implementation, tests, and rollout plan. This description is intentionally consolidated into a single string for PR export.

review_thread: Marcus Chen: Overall looks good. A few questions on thresholds in rules.yaml — can we avoid hard stops and present them as advisory by default?
Nina Kapoor: Agreed, made tolerances advisory in rules.yaml and added a CLI flag to enforce strict mode for gating (feature toggle).
Evelyn Park: Can the templater handle multi-binary diffs (e.g. quantized vs fp16) in the same family? Concerned about noisy notes.
Nina Kapoor: Yes — templater groups by variant-family and then collapse small token-level regressions under an 'implementation detail' bucket. Added sample output to examples/aggregated-changelog.
Diego Morales: nit: prefer smaller log volume, changed a few debug logs to debug-level. Also requested an additional e2e test for tokenizer drift edge-case.
Nina Kapoor: Added the tokenizer edge-case test (tests/test_heuristics.py) and fixed logging. CI flaked once on fuzz-heuristics and was rerun — green afterward.
release_notes:
- Add release-note aggregation pipeline that groups delta entries into sections (performance, API/schema, quantization notes)
- Add compat-heuristics validator that emits advisory warnings during onboarding (tokenizer drift, embedding-dim mismatches, output-shape deltas)
- CLI flag --aggregate-release-notes for maintainers to opt-in to aggregated changelogs
- Integration with release-assembler so aggregated notes and advisories are embedded into packaged changelogs
notes_on_rollout: Start as opt-in for model owners; heuristic advisories are advisory by default. Monitor metrics channel for advisory rate (registry.compat.advisory.count) and human overrides. After 4 weeks consider flipping strict-mode for new onboarding if advisory noise < 5%.
security_implications: compat-heuristics only emits advisory metadata and does not change model binaries or signing. Rules.yaml is non-executable and loaded by the validator service; we added a schema validation step to avoid malicious rule injection.
